frontLapPoseCoverageDiagnostic.evidenceBoundary: For neutral, crouch, and sit, bind exact body triangle IDs to rest-pose front-facing surface normals and the declared 10–90% UpperLeg bone interval, then cast along each evaluated posed body normal against each authored front-lap panel. Report left/right lap to left/right anterior thigh separately plus a deduplicated union, nearest panel face provenance, ray gaps, and a diagnostic-only 30 mm near-distance count with 0.5 mm versus 0.1 mm origin-offset sensitivity. This is a geometric diagnostic only; it does not establish pressure, stretch, material behavior, Shape Key response, fit, visual quality, or runtime acceptance.

zoneSelection.pelvisPosterior: mean Hips vertex-group weight >= 0.50 and posed surface normal world-Y >= 0.15
